lease_expiry_renewal.evidence: src/pando_gateway/pack_store.rs publish tx2: only after all four retention::activate() calls returned true does it call retention::renew_publication(&*tx, manifest.id) before insert_ready_manifest_in/record_manifest/commit. renew_publication sets lease_until=now+3600 for every fence row of that manifest inside the activation tx, so the protected window starts at activation rather than at reservation.
lease_expiry_renewal.residual: P3-1/P3-3 below (no proof that renew touched 4 rows; proof failure surfaces as a generic conflict).

serving_cas_proof_all_callsites.evidence: retention::verify_publication_ready joins pando_manifest_artifacts to pando_remote_artifacts AND pando_publication_fences on (authority,tenant,namespace,sha), filters a.state='active' AND p.lease_until>clock_timestamp(), takes FOR SHARE OF a,p, and requires rows.len()==4. Called in the same transaction as the serving mutation at three sites: src/pando_gateway/publish.rs before pack_ids.push(pack.id) and before DELETE pando_publication_fences; src/pando_gateway/transition/fence.rs complete_cutover before the pando_repository_states upsert that sets pack_ids=ARRAY[pack.id]; src/storage_lifecycle/pando.rs repack before the pack_ids CAS. FOR SHARE blocks a concurrent mark UPDATE ... WHERE state='active' until the CAS transaction ends, so no retire can slip between proof and commit.

publisher_paused_past_fence.evidence: If a publisher is stopped past the 1h lease, GC may mark and (after grace) delete; when it resumes, verify_publication_ready returns false because either the join yields fewer than 4 rows (fence gone/expired) or a.state is no longer 'active' (retired/deleting/deleted). publish.rs then returns conflict BEFORE pack_ids.push and BEFORE the fence delete, so no ref CAS can commit against deleted ciphertext; the pg tx rolls back leaving the manifest an orphan. A retry through reserve() also cannot reuse the path: reserve now computes fence_live for (manifest,namespace,sha) and only reuses an active artifact when fence_live != Some(false), so an expired fence forces a generation bump, a new g path and a fresh fence (asserted in tests/pando_maintenance.rs late section: path differs, verify false while un-uploaded, artifact state reserved).

fresh_generation_on_retired_deleting.evidence: reserve() bumps pando_storage_authorities.generation and writes a new remote_path for any existing non-active row, or when the fence for that manifest is expired; claim/still/finalize CAS are all scoped to the frozen remote_path + claim_generation, so a stale deleter can only remove the abandoned old path. The resurrection assertion (stale finalize == 0) is unchanged in tests/pando_maintenance.rs.

repack_fence_clear_atomic.evidence: src/storage_lifecycle/pando.rs repack: within one tx it rows-locks repositories+pando_repository_states FOR UPDATE, re-checks the exact serving snapshot, calls verify_publication_ready, runs the pack_ids CAS (changed==1), then DELETE FROM pando_publication_fences WHERE manifest_id=$1, then the storage_maintenance_repo_state update, then commit. No commit point exists between the CAS and the fence delete.

findings.title: Serving proof counts joined rows instead of distinct artifacts
findings.repro: If two of the four artifact_role links ever pointed at the same (namespace,sha256) - only possible if pack and index ciphertext were byte-identical, which random per-object nonces prevent - the join would emit two rows for one fence and rows.len() could still reach 4 with only three distinct objects verified.
findings.fix_request: Use SELECT count(DISTINCT (l.namespace,l.sha256)) ... = 4 (and keep FOR SHARE) for an exact cardinality proof.

findings.title: Proof failure surfaces as a generic conflict and requires a full republish
findings.source: src/pando_gateway/publish.rs returns conflict() on verify failure; src/pando_gateway/transition/fence.rs returns conflict(); src/storage_lifecycle/pando.rs bails with republish.
findings.repro: A push paused longer than PENDING_PUBLICATION_SECONDS (3600s) is rejected with Pando refs changed; retry from current refs, which does not tell the operator that the publication window expired and a republish is needed. For cutover the retry path must re-run PackStore::publish to mint a new manifest and fences (verified for the repack job retry by inspection, not verified for the cutover retry in this pass).
findings.fix_request: Return a distinct expired-publication error (e.g. 409 reason publication_expired) and document that cutover retries republish; or extend the fence at each CAS attempt.

findings.title: renew_publication does not verify it touched four fence rows
findings.source: src/pando_gateway/retention.rs renew_publication: UPDATE pando_publication_fences SET lease_until=... WHERE manifest_id=$1 and ignore the row count
findings.repro: If a manifest ever reaches activation without fence rows (restore-imported manifests pass publication=None), renew silently updates 0 rows and the later serving proof fails closed with a generic conflict instead of a clear diagnostic.
findings.fix_request: Compare the returned row count with the expected 4 (or with the number of manifest_artifacts rows) and error out.

findings.title: Fixture simulates the serving CAS with two separate statements
findings.source: tests/pando_maintenance.rs: UPDATE pando_publication_fences SET lease_until=now-1s; later DELETE FROM pando_publication_fences; then UPDATE pando_repository_states pack_ids=array_append(...) outside a shared transaction
findings.repro: A regression that made the production fence delete and pack_ids update non-atomic would not be caught by the fixture, because the fixture never exercises the atomic pairing.
findings.fix_request: Drive the fixture through the production serving path (or wrap fence delete + pack_ids append in one transaction) after retention::verify_publication_ready succeeds.
